issues.display_title: Issue #273: [Feature] Implement Keycloak SSO Login with Dynamic Feature Flag Switcher
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

Windows:

2026-10-20.14-31-33.mp4

Mac:

Screen.Recording.2026-10-20.at.15.26.39.mov

📌 Overview

Implement Keycloak-based Single Sign-On (SSO) authentication using OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Flow + PKCE (S256) via a native Deep Link callback (\gothru-photo-studio://auth-sso) on the Tauri v2 desktop application.

The app also features a Dynamic Auth Switcher driven by the endpoint \GET /v1/feature-flags?env=dev|live:

  • \keycloak_auth: true\ ➔ Render single Keycloak SSO Login button.
  • \keycloak_auth: false\ ➔ Fallback to the legacy manual login form (Email & Password) + Google OAuth button.

🎯 Objectives & Scope

  1. Tauri v2 Native Infrastructure:

    • Register custom deep link scheme \gothru-photo-studio\ in \ auri.conf.json.
    • Install \ auri-plugin-single-instance\ (with feature \deep-link) to ensure browser redirect callbacks refocus the existing window instead of spawning a new instance on Windows/Linux.
    • Configure capabilities \http:default\ with an explicit allowlist scope for Keycloak and GoThru API domains.
    • Register scheme at startup via \deep_link().register_all()\ for Windows/Linux dev mode.

  2. Frontend Authentication Module (\keycloak.ts):

    • Generate SHA-256 PKCE pair (\code_verifier, \code_challenge) and anti-CSRF \state\ &
      once.
    • Open system default browser via @tauri-apps/plugin-opener.
    • Intercept callback URL via @tauri-apps/plugin-deep-link\ listener.
    • Exchange authorization code for Keycloak tokens via @tauri-apps/plugin-http\ (CORS-free).
    • Exchange Keycloak token for GoThru session token and Session ID (\sid) via \POST /v1/auth/keycloak-login.
    • Handle backend logout via \POST /v1/auth/logout\ with payload { sid }.

  3. UI / UX Layer (\Login.tsx):

    • Query feature flags at \GET /v1/feature-flags?env=dev|live.
    • Conditionally render Keycloak SSO when active; fallback to the manual email/password form and Google login when inactive or offline.
    • Preserve original styling, laptop mockup illustration, theme selector, and language selector.

  4. Documentation:

    • Produce a reusable SSO migration guide for other Tauri desktop apps at \docs/tauri-keycloak-sso-migration-guide.md.

Result from Developer

📋 Final Implementation Summary — Ready for Review

The Keycloak SSO implementation and dynamic authentication switcher have been completed, verified, and are ready for QA / review.

🌟 Key Deliverables & Enhancements

  1. Native Desktop SSO Flow (OAuth 2.0 PKCE S256):

    • Protocol Scheme: Handled via gothru-photo-studio://auth-sso.
    • Single-Instance Enforcement: tauri-plugin-single-instance routes browser redirect deep links directly to the active application window.
    • Native Rust Token Exchange: Added sso_exchange_token command in src-tauri/src/commands/auth.rs using reqwest::Client, eliminating browser Origin headers and fully bypassing Keycloak CORS restrictions.
    • Storage Reliability: Mirrored PKCE context in both sessionStorage and localStorage, ensuring context survives desktop protocol switches and OS refocusing.

  2. Dynamic Auth Switcher (Feature Flag Integration):

    • Queries GET /v1/feature-flags?env=dev|live on startup.
    • keycloak_auth: true: Renders the modern "Login with GoThru" SSO button.
    • keycloak_auth: false (or offline/fallback): Seamlessly restores the legacy manual login form (Email & Password), Continue with Google button, and Forgot Password / Sign up links.
    • No UI Flickering: Integrated initial loading spinner while feature flags resolve.

  3. Pixel-Perfect Verification & Success Screen:

    • Backdrop Blur Modal: Centered status card overlay with ambient shadow (shadow-[0_30px_90px_-15px_rgba(0,0,0,0.4)]).
    • Brand Alignment: Utilizes the official GoThru brand logo (gothru-logo.png).
    • In-Progress Stage: Dual-ring progress indicator (148px) with rotating blue arc and 42px shield-check icon, along with sequential step tracking (account verified, session created, profile loaded).
    • Completed Stage: Transitions to the 360° planetary lens animation (panning panorama mountains, orbiting gradient ring, green pop-up check badge, twinkling stars) with a personalized greeting (Welcome back, {User Name}).
    • 2-Second Hold: Pauses on the success screen for 2000ms before navigating into the Photo Studio workspace.

  4. Redesigned SSO Action Button:

    • Primary blue button (#1a6cf0) with soft elevation shadow (shadow-[0_8px_20px_-4px_rgba(26,108,240,0.55)]).
    • Left-aligned white rounded badge containing the official GoThru icon.
    • Centered label: Login with GoThru.

  5. Quality & Documentation:

    • pnpm test: 266 unit tests passing (100%).
    • pnpm typecheck: 0 errors.
    • cargo check: Passed cleanly with zero compilation errors.
    • Reusable migration guide available in docs/tauri-keycloak-sso-migration-guide.md.

issues.display_title: Issue #274: Add Background Music Option (Browse or Template) to Video Merger
issues.main_description_html:
DEMO FROM DEVELOPER

Screen.Recording.2026-10-19.at.16.18.31.mov

Description:

Add a Background Music dropdown to the Video Merger settings so users can add a soundtrack to the merged video. The dropdown offers:

  • No Music (default)
  • Browse...: pick a local audio file (mp3, wav, m4a, aac, ogg, flac)
  • Templates: 37 built-in GoThru tracks (A Chill In The Air, Change Is Coming, ..., Remember Me)

Template audio is fetched from https://gothru.co/music/<Track_Name_With_Underscores>.mp3 (e.g. https://gothru.co/music/Change_Is_Coming.mp3) and cached locally after the first download.

Expected behavior:

  • Music loops to cover the whole video and is cut when the video ends.
  • Mute Audio off: the music is mixed with the clip audio.
  • Mute Audio on: only the music plays and the clip audio is dropped.
  • The FFmpeg live preview regenerates when the music changes and plays with sound while music is selected.
  • The final merge output includes the selected music.
  • The backend only accepts template URLs under https://gothru.co/music/. Local files must exist.

Out of scope (possible follow-up):

  • Music volume slider. FFmpeg amix currently halves the music and clip audio levels.
  • Fade-out at the end of the track.
  • Translations for non-English locales (they fall back to en).

issues.display_title: Issue #270: Issue: The Gothru app does not appear in the list of JPG file viewer options.
issues.main_description_html:
Demo

Result from Developer

Resolved via commit fdd132b on branch development.

Summary of Changes:

  1. File Association Declaration (tauri.conf.json):
    • Added bundle.fileAssociations for supported image extensions (.jpg, .jpeg, .png, .tif, .tiff, .dng, .nef, .raf, .cr2, .cr3).
  2. Windows Shell & Registry Integration (hooks.nsh & windows_assoc.rs):
    • Registered ProgID GoThruPhotoStudio.Image, Applications\GoThru Photo Studio.exe (SupportedTypes, shell\open\command), OpenWithProgids entries, and Capabilities\RegisteredApplications.
    • Added NSIS hooks for post-install setup and pre-uninstall cleanup with shell change notification (SHChangeNotify).
    • Added runtime self-registration to HKCU on Windows launch so portable/dev builds appear in the "Open With" / "Suggested apps" menu immediately.
  3. Argument Parsing & Single Instance Handling (lib.rs, app.rs):
    • Fixed CLI path resolution for Windows drive letter arguments.
    • Dispatches open-file-with on warm start via tauri-plugin-single-instance.
    • Stores startup argument for cold start, exposed via get_initial_open_file.
  4. Renderer File Selection (files.ts, Content.tsx):
    • Switched path matching to case- and slash-insensitive (pathTool.isSamePath).
    • Loads parent directory, syncs latest-dir, and focuses/selects the opened image in Preview mode.
